settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure business info and AI behavior. Changes take effect immediately.
settings.businessNote: AI uses this info to generate more relevant analysis and marketing content.
settings.localeNote: Localization for overseas markets: UI language, currency, date and AI output language.
settings.languageNote: The entire platform UI refreshes to the selected language immediately.
settings.aiReplyLangNote: Affects review replies, email drafts and marketing content.
settings.modelsNote: Connect your own LLM API Keys. Connected models are used first for AI assistant and content generation; otherwise the platform built-in model is used. Keys are encrypted and only readable server-side.
settings.modelAssignNote: Choose which model powers each AI capability. Auto mode routes by task complexity and can save 40-60% of cost.

capNote.content: Marketing copy, review replies, email drafts

settings.autoModeNote: In auto mode, light tasks (review replies, email classification) use the lightweight model while complex analysis uses your connected flagship model.
settings.keyEncrypted: Encrypted at rest, readable only by the server, never shown in plain text after saving.
settings.mailboxNote: Bind business or personal mailboxes so AI can send and receive real emails. Credentials are encrypted.
settings.gmailNote: Works with Gmail app passwords via secure SMTP/IMAP
settings.outlookNote: For teams on Microsoft business mail
settings.appPasswordNote: Enable 2FA in your mail provider, generate an app password, then sign in below via secure SMTP/IMAP. OAuth one-click authorization is on the roadmap.
settings.passwordHint: Business mail usually requires a client authorization code
settings.credentialsEncrypted: Encrypted at rest, used only by the server to send and receive mail.
settings.automationNote: Boundaries for AI-driven outbound mail to avoid disturbing customers or landing in spam.
settings.autoReplyNote: AI replies are sent automatically; when off, each reply needs manual confirmation in the email center.
settings.alertEmailsNote: Notify the owner via the default mailbox when a review below 3 stars arrives.
settings.briefingEmailsNote: Send the AI daily briefing to the owner's mailbox at 06:30.
settings.integrationsNote: Connect external ERP / POS / payment systems. Synced data feeds AI analysis and alerts. Platform data is used when nothing is connected.
settings.erpNote: Open-source ERP: inventory / purchasing / suppliers / finance
settings.erpUrlNote: Frappe Cloud or self-hosted ERPNext site URL
settings.erpSecretNote: Generate in ERPNext under User > API Access. Encrypted at rest.
settings.squareHint: After saving the Access Token, POS orders sync in real time via webhook.
settings.shopifyHint: Online orders sync automatically once connected.
settings.stripeHint: Configure the Secret Key to enable payments and reconciliation.
settings.paypalNote: Backup payment channel for overseas customers
settings.paypalHint: Configure Client ID / Secret to enable PayPal checkout.

intTips.square: Get the Access Token in Square Developer Console > Credentials. The webhook URL is generated after saving.
intTips.shopify: Create a custom app in Shopify Admin > Apps > Develop apps to get the Admin API token.
intTips.stripe: Find keys in Stripe Dashboard > Developers > API keys. Add the webhook endpoint after saving.
intTips.paypal: Create an app in PayPal Developer Dashboard to get Client ID / Secret.

settings.comingSoon: Coming soon: Uber Eats / DoorDash merchant centers (their APIs are partner-only, application in progress).
settings.comingSoonNote: Tell us which systems you need and we will prioritize them.
settings.aiNote: Control AI reply style and automation level.
settings.autoReviewReplyNote: Drafts are created for new reviews and published after manual confirmation.
settings.churnAlertNote: Push an alert to the dashboard when a customer score drops below 40.
settings.dailyBriefingNote: Generate yesterday's summary at 08:00 and push it to the AI assistant.
settings.dataNote: Overview of business data currently in the database.
settings.wipeWarning: Delete all sample business data (products / orders / customers / reviews / emails) to start entering real data. This cannot be undone.
settings.wipeConfirm: All sample products, orders, customers, reviews, emails and knowledge docs will be deleted. This action cannot be undone. Continue?
